summary: Enhance your skills in dissemination and implementation research through our specialized training course. Join now to take your knowledge to the next level.
lede: Dissemination and implementation research examines how evidence-based interventions move into routine practice and how their uptake and sustainment are assessed. For researchers, program managers, and quality improvement professionals, the course develops practical ways to analyze barriers with CFIR, plan evaluation with RE-AIM, and select strategies for adoption and adaptation. Participants also practice stakeholder engagement, measurement design, and sustainment planning to report implementation results clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to move evidence into routine use, evaluate uptake, and report credible implementation results. It suits people who already work with interventions, programs, or research evidence and now need a structured D&I research approach.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of research methods, program delivery, or quality improvement; familiarity with basic data interpretation; and comfort reading implementation studies. Coding is not required for completion. Participants should bring a laptop for framework exercises, template completion, and digital review of case materials. Advanced topics such as pragmatic trial design and mixed methods are taught at an operational level, with emphasis on selecting and applying the right approach rather than statistical engineering.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
